title: Software Engineer, AI Data - Boise, ID, USA
description:
Mission
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify 's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.
We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.
What Yo u’ ll Do:

• Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.

• Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

• Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.

• Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

• A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.

• Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.

• Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.

• Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

• Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

• Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

• A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

• A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

• Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

• The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

• Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

• The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

• An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio - a rapidly evolving tech domain

Compensation: The United States base salary range for this full-time position is $140,000-$200,000 + bonus + equity depending on experience

title: AI Tooling Engineer - Remote
description:
About Us
At Zyte , we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte . Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 225 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.
For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.
This role sits in Zyte 's Tooling team, working side by side with our Principal Engineer in Tooling on an internal agentic platform: one place that brings together what the company knows, today spread across many systems, so that people and their AI agents get that context in one place, each seeing only what they are allowed to see.
We are looking for a builder: someone who has built AI agents and shipped them to real users, and who likes owning a product end to end, from talking with the people who use it to the code, the deployment and the numbers that say whether it works. The first version is already in use inside the company and grows every week.
Roles & Responsibilities:

• Build the platform with the Principal Engineer in Tooling: new capabilities every week, from design to production.

• Connect new internal systems and SaaS tools to the platform: their APIs and data, how they fit a shared model, and who may see what.

• Build agents and the tools they use, including MCP servers that agents across the company can call, and the context they need to answer well.

• Own quality: evaluation sets and benchmarks, tracing, cost per answer, and fixing what users run into.

• Turn proofs of concept into internal tools that run in production in the cloud, with security and access done properly.

• Build with AI coding agents as the main way of working, with the specs, tests and reviews that keep the code sound.

• Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives: evaluating and standardising internal AI tools, cost and usage tracking, and agreed standards for AI-built internal apps; help other teams build on the platform.

• Talk with the people who use the platform, across the company, to learn what to build next, and explain what was built to technical and non-technical audiences.

Requirements

• 3+ years building and shipping production software, mostly in Python, with relational databases.

• Has built and shipped with LangGraph at least one agent that real people use: tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt and context design.

• Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from the main providers, cost and token optimisation.

• Hands-on with MCP or similar tool protocols, as a server and as a client.

• Evaluates AI systems properly: test sets, LLM-as-judge, regressions when a prompt or a model changes; tracing and observability with Langfuse or similar.

• Integrates APIs and data: SaaS APIs, SQL, data warehouses.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud and/or AWS): containers, managed databases, identity and access, CI/CD.

• Uses AI coding agents every day and knows how to keep their output in check.

• A sense for security and permissions: identity, least privilege, people see only what they are allowed to see.

• Comfortable with version control (GitHub/Bitbucket).

• Excellent written and spoken English, technical and non-technical.

Desired Skills:

• Familiarity with web data or web scraping.

• Django and Postgres, including vector search with pgvector.

• Enough frontend to build and change a chat interface (React, Next.js).

• Has built internal tools that colleagues adopted

You will serve as the internal owner and technical authority for Digital Realty 's SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC) platform, defining how identity governance operates at enterprise scale. This role leads the Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) strategy, architecture, and delivery, ensuring access lifecycle management, certifications, and compliance controls are designed and executed to meet global regulatory and operational requirements. • Own and drive the multi-year IGA roadmap and strategy.

• Define SailPoint ISC architecture across Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) lifecycle processes, access certifications, role models, and connectors.

• Design integrations with Oracle HCM, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, ServiceNow, BeyondTrust, and Microsoft Sentinel.

• Strong expertise in access certifications, SOX User Access Reviews (UARs), audit readiness, and compliance engagement.

• DevOps mindset with hands-on experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and configuration-as-code methodologies.

title: USRN - Trainer

Job Summary
The USRN Trainer is responsible for delivering clinical and process training to healthcare professionals and support teams within a U.S. healthcare BPO environment. This role ensures that employees acquire the clinical knowledge, operational skills, and regulatory understanding necessary to perform effectively in various healthcare programs such as Utilization Management (UM), Case Management (CM), Triage, Appeals, and Claims Review.

The trainer will design, facilitate, and evaluate training programs that support operational excellence while maintaining compliance with U.S. healthcare standards, HIPAA regulations, and clinical guidelines. The role requires a strong clinical background, excellent communication skills, and the ability to translate complex medical and operational processes into effective training modules for adult learners.

The USRN Trainer collaborates closely with Operations, Quality Assurance, Clinical Leadership, and Learning & Development teams to ensure training materials remain current, relevant, and aligned with organizational and client expectations.

Key Responsibilities
- Training Delivery and Facilitation

• Facilitate comprehensive training programs for newly hired and tenured employees within U.S. healthcare accounts.

- Conduct instructor-led training sessions covering clinical workflows, healthcare regulations, documentation standards, and account-specific processes.

- Deliver training for healthcare programs including Utilization Management (UM), Case Management (CM), Triage, Appeals, and Claims Review.

- Ensure learners develop the necessary clinical judgment, critical thinking, and system navigation skills required for the program.

- Use various training delivery methods including classroom instruction, virtual training, simulations, case studies, and role-playing activities.

- Curriculum Development and Instructional Design

- Assist in the development, enhancement, and maintenance of training materials including presentations, job aids, learning guides, and assessment tools.

- Apply adult learning principles to create engaging and effective training experiences.

- Ensure training content aligns with U.S. healthcare standards, clinical guidelines, and organizational policies.

- Update training content regularly to reflect process improvements, regulatory updates, and client-specific changes.

Required Qualifications

Active and unrestricted U.S. Registered Nurse (USRN) license.

Minimum of 2-3 years clinical bedside experience in settings such as Emergency Room (ER), Intensive Care Unit (ICU), Medical-Surgical (Med-Surg), or Telemetry.

Minimum of 1 year experience as a USRN Trainer in a BPO or U.S. Healthcare account supporting programs such as Utilization Management (UM), Case Management (CM), Triage, Appeals, or Claims.

Strong knowledge of MCG/Milliman Care Guidelines, InterQual criteria, clinical guidelines, HIPAA requirements, and U.S. medical terminology.

Previous experience in training delivery, facilitation, or clinical education.

Familiarity with adult learning principles, curriculum design, and training methodologies.

Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written.

Strong presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.

Ability to conduct training in onsite, remote, or hybrid environments as required.

title: Social Strategist, X and Insights
description:

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are investing in our owned social channels to grow share of voice and tell a clearer, more connected company story across LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube. We need someone to take direct ownership of X and run it day to day, while also maintaining consistent social performance data analysis across all of our owned channels.

This is a hands-on social strategy role for someone who knows how to build an interesting, credible and active presence on X. You will also work with the Social Manager to turn channel and audience data into clear recommendations about what Harvey should create, publish, test, stop and scale. The goal is a steady feedback loop between how our audience behaves, what our content strategy is and how our creative gets made.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

OWN X STRATEGY AND EXECUTION

- Own Harvey's X strategy, programming and daily execution.

- Develop a distinctive voice and a clear role for Harvey on the platform.

- Create posts built for X, not LinkedIn content with the formatting changed.

- Find proactive, reactive and real-time opportunities for Harvey to join relevant conversations.

- Support product launches, research, events, partnerships, customer stories and company announcements on X.

- Build recurring formats and programming that give people a reason to come back.

- Write and edit copy that is clear, sharp and right for the platform.

- Monitor replies, mentions and relevant conversations.

- Work with the Social Content and Community Manager on engagement and response coverage.

- Support founder, executive and employee amplification where it makes sense.

- Use sound judgment in moments that carry brand, reputational or customer sensitivity.

- Track changes to X and adjust our approach as the platform evolves.

MANAGING CROSS-CHANNEL INSIGHTS AND OPTIMIZATION

- Work with Social Manager and Social Content and Community Manager to pull weekly and monthly performance analysis across X, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

- Collaborate with the social team to go beyond surface metrics and explain what actually drove performance.

- Identify patterns across format, topic, audience, timing, creative approach and distribution.

- Help turn findings into specific programming and creative recommendations.

- Work with third party analytics tools to track follower growth, reach, engagement, clicks, sentiment and other channel-specific signals.

- Analyze performance during major launches, events and campaigns utilizing third party analytics and channel analytics.

- Work with Content Operations on data accuracy, UTMs, reporting processes and dashboards.

- Bring audience and performance insight into quarterly strategy and planning.

• Physical data models

• Schemas

• Pipelines

Ensure all data structures conform to:

• Enterprise standards

• Platform contracts

Define data interfaces required by:

• Internal AI teams

• External model providers

Support:

• Model versioning

• Feature compatibility

• Performance validation

Ensure data pipelines and access patterns support multi-tenant environments, including:

• Customer data isolation and secure access controls

• Reuse of data pipelines across customers and deployments

Note: The underlying data model for multi-tenancy is governed by the Principal Manufacturing & Semantic Architect.

title: Recruiter - RBT Programs
description:
ABA Recruiter - Existing Market RBT Programs
Denver, CO | Full Time | Onsite
About the role
FronteraCare is seeking an experienced Recruiter to own and scale our Registered Behavior Technician hiring across our existing markets. Few workflows in our business have as direct a line to patient care as RBT recruiting: every RBT hired is a child who can start or continue therapy, which makes this one of the most impactful roles at FronteraCare. This is a high-volume role for someone who has already built strong recruiting instincts and is ready to take a program that's up and running and push it further, improving speed, quality, and consistency as we grow. You'll travel to New Mexico periodically to stay close to the market and the teams you're hiring for.

You'll report to the Talent Lead and work alongside a Recruiter focused on emerging markets, with this role dedicated specifically to owning full-cycle recruiting for BT and RBT roles in FronteraCare's established markets. This is a great fit for someone who thrives in high-volume, fast-moving recruiting environments, finds genuine reward in the grind of consistent high-volume hiring, and brings both process discipline and compassion to every candidate interaction.

What is ABA?
Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) is a therapy that uses evidence-based techniques to help children with autism build communication, social, and daily living skills. Care is typically delivered one-on-one by Behavior Technicians and Registered Behavior Technicians under the guidance of a licensed Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), with progress tracked closely so each child's plan can be adjusted as they grow.

What you'll do

• Own full cycle recruiting for BT and RBT roles across FronteraCare's existing markets, from sourcing and screening through offer and onboarding handoff

• Take ownership of established sourcing channels and candidate pipelines, refining and scaling what's already working rather than building from scratch

• Maintain a high, consistent volume of active requisitions, balancing speed with quality in a fast-moving, high-turnover talent pool

• Travel to New Mexico periodically to build local candidate and community relationships and stay close to market conditions

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, clinical leaders, BCBAs, and current RBTs to stay close to market needs, referral opportunities, and what makes candidates want to join and stay

• Partner with the Talent Lead, the emerging markets Recruiter, onboarding, and HR to keep processes efficient and aligned across the broader recruiting team

• Proactively source candidates using Indeed and other established sourcing platforms, with an eye toward continuous improvement of what's already in place

• Post job openings on job boards and social media channels

• Coordinate and schedule interviews, manage calendars, and lead candidate communications

• Maintain accurate candidate records in Greenhouse and track key recruiting metrics

• Support additional recruiting projects and initiatives as needed to help the team meet its hiring goals

What you'll bring

• Associate's or bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field

• 3-5 years of recruiting experience in a high-volume setting, ideally in healthcare or behavioral health

• Demonstrated experience recruiting for junior or entry-level profiles, with a genuine appreciation for the pace and repetition that high-volume hiring requires

• A track record of taking an existing recruiting program and improving its speed, quality, or scale

• Familiarity with sourcing tools such as Indeed, as well as applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse experience a plus)

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

• Willingness and ability to travel to New Mexico periodically

• A compassionate, people-first mind

description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

ABOUT THE JOB

Most product marketers spend their careers making an average product sound better than it is. This role is the opposite.

We have built something rare: AI infrastructure that CPG teams genuinely love and will not give up. The stickiness is real, and category leaders keep choosing us. What we have not done yet is tell the world why we are better, and that gap is wide.

Today our positioning, customer proof, and competitive story are spread thin across the team. Our product is ahead of its story, and you close that gap. You own how our products show up in the market: how each area is positioned, why we win, and how we turn product and customer moments into demand. You power the GTM team with a story sharp enough to sell on, and you help define the category we are building.

This is a founding role. You are one of the first PMMs at Confido, here early enough to shape how the whole function works. Product Marketing reports to the VP of Marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You own strategy, programming, and the moments: what gets said, to whom, and where. This is a role for someone who wants to make the thing, not brief it out.

Own

- An integrated plan connecting the product roadmap to the marketing calendar across lifecycle, social, partnerships, AEO, and brand moments

We measure product marketing on the pipeline it moves and the deals it wins, not on activity.

- Deal velocity and win rate (primary). Sharp positioning and enablement move qualified deals faster and beat the alternatives more often

- Launch impact. New products are measured on adoption and the pipeline they generate, not on shipping

- Enablement effectiveness. Reps are equipped, using your assets, and able to defend against competitors in live deals

- 7+ years in product marketing. This is a clear PMM role, and we want someone who has done the craft, not an adjacent function

- Ideally in one of two worlds: CPG or commerce software, building the workflows our customers already live in, or B2B technology, where you translated genuinely complex products into clear entry points

- Excellent writing and narrative instincts. You turn a complex product into sharp, credible positioning

- Financial and quantitative fluency: comfortable reporting on pipeline influence and deal velocity

• Future-channel creative scouting: Stay ahead on what's next - Reddit, emerging short-video platforms - and maintain a point of view on what creative approach earns a pilot slot.

• Brand coherence at speed: Keep creatives on-strategy across multiple markets while preserving the velocity TikTok and new platforms demand.

Pharmacists must hold an active license in each required state before providing coverage.

About the Role

Join our telepharmacy team to support hospitals across multiple states through remote medication order review, clinical consultation, and transitions-of-care services. You’ll apply clinical expertise, navigate multiple electronic medical records and pharmacy systems, and collaborate with healthcare teams to promote safe medication use and optimal patient outcomes.
We’re looking for a pharmacist who takes personal accountability for the care they provide, communicates effectively, and works independently while remaining responsive to clients and fellow team members.

What You’ll Do

Telepharmacy & Clinical Services

• Evaluate prescriber orders for safety, efficacy, and appropriateness across multiple electronic medical records and pharmacy systems.

• Perform remote medication order entry, verification, and transitions-of-care medication reconciliation.

• Review dosing, renal and hepatic adjustments, allergies, drug interactions, therapeutic duplication, and compatibilities.

• Collaborate with physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals to clarify orders, resolve medication concerns, and recommend optimal therapy consistent with applicable standards and client protocols.

• Provide timely drug information and therapeutic guidance to support safe medication practices.

• Provide medication education, as applicable to assigned services, including proper use, potential side effects, and expected outcomes.

• Apply clinical knowledge to the needs of patients across the lifespan, from neonates through geriatrics, including pregnant and nursing patients and those with renal or hepatic impairment.

• Maintain working knowledge of hospital therapies, including but not limited to IV medications, cardiac and narcotic infusions, and IV antibiotics.

Communication & Operational Excellence

• Accurately and promptly document completed tasks, medication-related interventions, and clinical recommendations in designated order management and clinical systems.

• Build effective working relationships with contracted hospitals, healthcare teams, and fellow pharmacists.

• Coordinate client coverage, communicate workload needs, and assist teammates as priorities shift.

• Monitor assigned order queues and team communications to support timely processing and follow-up.

• Follow applicable pharmacy laws, professional standards, HIPAA requirements, and organizational and client policies.

Technology & Independent Practice

• Navigate multiple electronic medical records, pharmacy information systems, and automation platforms.

• Use Google Workspace and other applications needed for daily work.

• Troubleshoot routine access and workflow issues and escalate concerns appropriately.

• Maintain required licenses, credentials, training, and system access.

• Prioritize work across multiple hospital clients while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

Training & Performance

• Complete required onboarding and ongoing clinical, system, and policy training.

• Stay current with client workflows, medication safety practices, and operational updates.

• Meet established quality, productivity, and turnaround-time expectations.

• Participate in evening, overnight, rotating weekend, on-call, and holiday coverage as assigned.

Qualifications

• Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy or Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree required; PharmD prefer

title: Administration Assistant (NDIS) - Payroll, Rostering and Finance Administration
description:
About the Company

Our client is an NDIS provider, established in 2022, preparing to become a registered provider and delivering core support and capacity building to around 120 participants with a team of around 45 to 50 staff. They are looking for one dedicated, full-time Administration Assistant to take over the repeatable, process-driven administration currently handled by the management team, so the team can stay focused on participants, staff and growing the business.

About the Role

This is a hands-on administration role centred on payroll preparation, finance administration, rostering support and compliance documentation. You will work in Xero, the client's rostering system (ShiftCare) and a custom-built CRM, follow documented processes exactly, and prepare work for review and approval by the Operations and Administration Manager. The role does not approve payments or pay runs. It prepares, checks and flags. It also prepares standard documents and contracts from approved templates and maintains the policy and procedure register, without changing template terms or policy content.

The role suits a careful, procedure-driven administrator with solid Australian payroll and Xero experience, who reports anomalies instead of correcting them silently, and who handles personal and confidential information with care. Attention to detail is the top priority, along with a teachable, collaborative approach to learning the client's way of working. A healthcare or nursing background is not required; a background in bookkeeping, information management or program administration is what matters, and NDIS awareness is favourable. The final task list will be confirmed with the client through a task transfer exercise, and the role will grow as processes are documented and handed over, with additional tasks within the scope of the role (for example, preparing staff training documents) added over time.

In practice, shift adjustments, roster changes and CRM administration are expected to take more daily time than payroll itself. Payroll, billing and invoicing form a concentrated block of work in each pay cycle (indicatively around one working day), alongside roughly an hour a day of ongoing bookkeeping and an hour a day of shift management. These are indicative estimates, to be confirmed in the task transfer. Training will be provided through guided walkthroughs by the Operations and Administration Manager.

Primary Purpose

To give the client's management team accurate, well-checked payroll and finance administration, an up-to-date and clash-free roster, organised compliance and recruitment records, accurate documents prepared from approved templates, a well-maintained policy and procedure register, accurate shift and billing records, and a reliable daily update on what has been done and what is next.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Preparation

• Prepare pay runs in Xero for approval, applying award-based pay rates, overtime, penalty rates, superannuation and leave entitlements

title: Director of Engineering
description:
WHO WE ARE

Aurelius is the autonomous directed energy company.

We are a group of engineers, operators, and company patriots building American-made, laser-based, counter-UAS defense systems that neutralize aerial threats.

We're a small team that designs in San Francisco, manufactures in Detroit, and field tests Archimedes, our fiber-laser counter-UAS system, weekly on our own 400-acre private range.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You'll own the path from R&D to production across the whole system, and run the engineering org that executes it.

This is the person who turns a demonstrator into a weapon system. You'll lead across software, firmware, controls, hardware integration, and test, and drive the handoff from a lab system to one that survives downrange and can be built at volume. You set technical direction, and you stay close enough to be useful in the lab and on the range.

As a Director of Engineering you will set technical direction, stand up the R&D to production transition, and build the team that delivers field-ready systems at volume. You'll work daily with the technical leads, manufacturing in Detroit, and the programs team that sits with customers.

MUST-HAVES

- Significant leadership of multi-disciplinary technical teams, with a track record taking complex hardware and software systems from R&D through production or field deployment

- You can earn the respect of specialists across software, controls, and hardware even if you are not the deepest person in every domain

- Demonstrated ability to scale teams and turn ambiguity into high-performing execution

- Comfort operating hands-on in a lab and on a test range, not just in planning tools

- U.S. citizenship (required for export control).

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Priority deliverables in the first 6 months:

- A clear technical direction and authority architecture across software, firmware, controls, hardware integration, and test

- The R&D to production plan: what has to be true for subsystems to be field-ready and manufacturable, with owners and dates

- Field test leadership for upcoming range campaigns, from test article design through scoring system performance in non-lab conditions

- A hiring and team structure plan for the engineering org, and the first key seats filled or in late stages

- A working interface with programs and customers so mission requirements turn into engineering execution, not a pile of tickets

NICE TO HAVES

It would help if…

- Directed energy or high energy laser weapon system experience

- Experience standing up engineering processes and tooling for a scaling org

- Track record of hiring and growing senior technical talent

- Active security clearance or ability to obtain one.

NOT A FIT IF

- You're a people leader who has stepped away from the technical work and would not be useful in the lab or on the range

- You've only managed a single discipline, or you've never taken a system through production or field deployment

- You need remote or hybrid work

HOW WE WORK

At Aurelius we work what we call, 5+X. Our core operating hours are 5 days a week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Pacific Time.

The X is the honest acknowledgment that hard work sometimes takes more. For engineering, that means late nights and weekends during sprints and ramp-up periods.

For growth, ops, and support, it means conferences, deployments, and events when the mission calls for it.

This role is onsite 5 days a week in San Francisco.

title: Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Malta
description:
Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Malta
Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Malta. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.
The programme
An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.
The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.
What you will work on
The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.
What you bring
Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.
Useful but not essential:
A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.
About Yadimen
Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

title: Sales Manager (EU)
description:
About CoVet

CoVet is an AI copilot application built to assist veterinary professionals by saving them time and allowing them to focus more on animal care-or even get home on time. We are a small, passionate, and agile team with a strong mission to improve the veterinary industry through innovative technology.

As a fast-growing, mission-driven technology company, we are expanding into the European market and seeking a Sales Manager to lead our regional growth efforts.

This is an opportunity to take on a key leadership role within our sales organization, supporting and developing a high-performing team while driving the strategic growth of our user base in the EU.

About the role

As a Sales Manager, EU, you'll focus on coaching and mentoring our sales team to optimize conversions, expand our user base, and deliver outstanding results in our growing European market. You’ll play a critical role in building a high-performing team that drives sustainable growth and customer success.

What you'll do

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of sales professionals across the EU region to meet and exceed performance targets.

• Provide hands-on coaching, ensuring the team effectively communicates product value and overcomes objections.

• Design and implement scalable training programs focused on consultative selling, product knowledge, and sales methodologies.

• Develop and refine sales strategies to optimize lead conversion and drive sustainable revenue growth.

• Set clear KPIs and manage team performance through regular reviews, performance metrics, and continuous feedback.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and customer success teams to align on messaging and go-to-market strategies.

• Oversee and manage the sales pipeline, ensuring accurate forecasting, timely follow-ups, and opportunity progression.

• Utilize HubSpot CRM to monitor team performance, analyze data, and identify improvement opportunities.

• Ensure the team delivers solutions that address customer pain points and align with CoVet ’s value proposition.

• Act as a liaison for EU market feedback to inform product and operational improvements.

• Support the team in contract negotiations, renewals, and upselling efforts to maximize customer lifetime value.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in SaaS sales, with at least 2 years in a leadership or management role.

• Demonstrated track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets while leading successful teams.

• Strong coaching and leadership skills, with a focus on professional development and team growth.

• In-depth understanding of SaaS sales strategies, customer acquisition, and B2B sales cycles.

• Proficiency in using HubSpot or comparable CRM platforms.

• Fluent in English; additional fluency in one or more major EU languages (e.g., German, French, Spanish) is highly desirable.

• Experience working with healthcare, veterinary, or similar regulated industries is a plus.

• Based in the European Union, with availability to work across EU time zones.

Why Join Us?

• Competitive base salary with a performance-linked commission structure

• Flexible, remote-first working culture with emphasis on autonomy and results

• Be part of shaping the future of a growing, mission-driven company with real-world impact in veterinary care

• Inclusive and supportive team culture committed to equity and opportunity

•
Compensation: The salary range for this role varies by location and will be determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, qualifications, and local market conditions. The range included in this posting reflects the potential salary range across our hiring regions.

description:

This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own the manufacturing BOM and see that every vehicle and hardware build starts on time with the right parts, the right documentation and a team ready to build it correctly. This role sits at the intersection of hardware engineering, procurement and manufacturing.

You will work with mechanical, electrical and systems engineers to make the manufacturing BOM complete and accurate, review CAD and wiring harness designs and give actionable feedback before release. Acting as technical program manager for BOM procurement, you will set the procurement and manufacturing gates across multiple programs, direct procurement teams to hit them, and lead the technician team that builds the hardware. Your goal is faster, more efficient and higher-quality builds, from prototype through production.

Own the manufacturing BOM and build readiness

- Own the manufacturing BOM for each vehicle and hardware program; make sure it is complete, accurate and released in PLM ahead of every build.

- Know each build down to the detail: the exact count of harnesses and mechanical parts, and what each one does on each vehicle.

- Create harness schematics and drawings, and review mechanical CAD and electrical designs, giving engineers clear, actionable feedback before release.

- Use first-principles thinking to resolve fit, function and integration issues before they reach the build floor.

- Drive DFM/DFA and design-for-serviceability (DFS) reviews with Mechanical, Electrical and Systems Engineering.

Set procurement and manufacturing gates

- Serve as technical program manager for BOM procurement across multiple programs.

- Define and run procurement and manufacturing gates (Proto, EVT, DVT, PVT), including design-freeze, BOM-release, clear-to-build (CTB) and build-readiness criteria.

- Forecast procurement from manufacturing schedules and manage build schedules and CTB tracking across contract manufacturers (CMs), joint-development partners (JDMs) and internal teams.

- Lead procurement and sourcing teams to deliver parts on time: set priorities, track open POs and shortages, and escalate risks early.

- Manage BOM risk: identify single-source components, long-lead industrial parts and availability risks early in design.

- Partner with Strategic Sourcing to track COGS, manage tooling NRE budgets and execute cost-reduction roadmaps.

- Balance the speed of consumer-tech development with the safety, compliance and field-durability demands of industrial and heavy-vehicle deployments.

title: Senior System Test Engineer - Simulation
description:
What you will do
As a Simulation Test Engineer, you will own system-level simulation testing of our autonomous driving software. You will focus on the virtual verification and validation of both perception and autonomous. You will also provide support to Torc’s development and integration teams and be instrumental in growing the robustness and safety of our self-driving technology.

• Identify, plan, and execute simulation test campaigns for autonomous vehicle V&V efforts.

• Interface with Product, Systems, and Safety teams to develop V&V simulation strategies.

• Maintain and improve Torc's Scenario Library, containing Abstract, Logical, and Concrete scenarios to ensure robust ODD coverage.

• Acknowledge testing gaps and derive requirements for new or improved test tools, simulation environments, and test frameworks.

• Coordinate with internal tools teams and external vendors to evolve Torc's simulation and virtual testing toolchains.

• Perform in-depth analysis and triage of simulation results, including development of dashboards and test reports to communicate results clearly to stakeholders.
 
What you’ll need to succeed:

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics Engineering, Systems Engineering, or engineering equivalent with 6+ years of experience OR a Master's Degree with 3+ years of experience.

• Experience with virtual testing and simulation of perception and autonomous vehicle behavior.

• Experience developing scenarios compliant with the ASM OpenScenario standard, especially Abstract and/or Logical Scenarios.

• Experience developing Test Cases and Test Procedures.

• Scripting in .yaml and using Python for data analysis.

• Experience with software and system troubleshooting and problem-solving with specific focus on system-level analysis, fault isolation, and identification.

• Proficiency working in a Linux environment.

• Working knowledge of basic probability and linear algebra.

• Experience effectively reporting progress and test results to stakeholders.

• Familiar with the state-of-the-art approaches of autonomous vehicle validation.
Bonus Points!

• Automotive or similar test and validation experience.

• Experience with developing & validating sensor models, traffic vehicle models, and vehicle dynamics models.

• ROS (Robot Operating System).

• Ability to mentor lower-level engineers.
